build.title: Little Red Car
build.summary: A red car with four black wheels, a sloped cabin with blue side windows, yellow headlights at the front and orange taillights at the back.
steps: Stand four black round 1×1 bricks as wheels at the corners, 2 studs in from each end.
Lay five black 2×4 plates on top to make a chassis 10 studs long and 4 studs wide.
